newsitem.title: FINLAND: Enso says Oulu investment cost below plan.
newsitem.headline: Enso says Oulu investment cost below plan.

text.p: Finland's second largest forest industry group Enso said on Friday its investment in a new paper production line in Oulu would be 100 million to 200 million markka below the 2.7 billion markka estimate.
The new paper machine line PM7 was started on April 24, five weeks ahead of schedule, and production volume rose to 16,000 tonnes of mostly coated paper by Friday, it said.
"The cost estimate for the Oulu investment is FIM 2.7 billion; the actual cost will, however, be FIM 100-200 million less," Enso said in a statement.
